_about: Structural ratchet for src/ (scripts/structural-scorecard.mjs): counts that may only fall. A rise fails CI; a fall fails until this file is lowered with `node scripts/structural-scorecard.mjs --update`. Baseline 2026-10-28, origin/main 0f2400e. swallowedCatches 57 -> 64 when the rule widened to no-op bodies, bare return/continue/break and promise .catch(() => {}); the code did not change. Re-baselined 2026-11-02 on origin/main b5e9eda, counting code merged since 0f2400e: envVars 27 -> 6 (#367 moved worker configuration into one validated VITEST_NATIVE_CONTEXT); swallowedCatches 64 -> 61; globals 27 -> 32 (worker hooks added by merged fixes: __vitest_native_lost_file_error and __vitest_native_file_collected for hot file accounting #350, __vitest_native_v8_compile_cache, __vitest_native_rntl_jest, __vitest_native_permissive_modules); nodePatchSites 17 -> 20 (one each in rntl-hooks.mjs, report-error.mjs, rntl-support.mjs). The rises predate this ratchet and are recorded, not introduced. 2026-11-04, the ownership guard (ADR-0004 decision 5, accepted; docs/ownership-guard.md): nodePatchSites 20 -> 23 for its Node-side records, which have no hook that sees an evaluation with its module (Module.prototype._compile for CommonJS and require() of ES modules, the .mjs extension for Node versions that bypass _compile, the .json extension); globals 32 -> 33 for __vitest_native_ownership, the one channel the marker appended to Vite modules and the in-thread loader both call; envVars 6 -> 7 for VITEST_NATIVE_OWNERSHIP_MODE, a documented run-wide override read only in the main process (the guard's own configuration reaches workers in the project context).
